records.rationale: Pinned public tokenizer checksum, byte-verified against the actual model data and constrained by exact-value/path controls.
Two synthetic idempotency identifiers, six occurrences; contract test reconstructs each from typed action facts. No authentication capability. Exact-value/path controls verified.

limitations: Native telemetry was observed before explicit opt-out; initial network behavior was not traced. Later network-none evidence is separate. These are secret-detector records, not HIGH/CRITICAL CVEs.
